_comment: Legacy seed labels for the road-damage benchmark. Images are NOT committed: see eval/README.md. Production road-damage-v5 returns acceptable/rejected image quality and damaged/undamaged assessment with pothole_cavity, failed_patch, surface_breakup, rut_or_depression, or other_road_damage subtypes. This seed still uses legacy pothole/not_pothole binary labels until the owner re-labels each subtype. Only six photos were confirmed by the owner, all positive. Every negative is assistant-judged and UNVERIFIED, so this set cannot measure verified precision or act as a release gate. Disputed images remain excluded.

images.label: pothole
images.notes: Medium pothole with loose stones near the kerb, close range.

images.label: pothole
images.notes: Multiple eroded patches and open potholes near the lane line.

images.label: pothole
images.notes: Long strip of broken asphalt and loose aggregate across the lane. gpt-5-nano missed this one entirely, which is why the nano pre-screen was removed.

images.label: not_pothole
images.notes: Assistant-labelled roadside debris and an exposed drainage grate near the kerb. The current v5 model instead sees road-edge damage and accepted it in both recorded trials. The negative label is unverified and contributes only to provisional metrics until the owner rules whether damage crosses the actual road boundary.

images.label: not_pothole
images.notes: Assistant-labelled intact road with construction debris at the roadside. The current v5 model accepted it in both recorded trials, so the negative label requires owner review and contributes only to provisional metrics.

images.label: disputed
images.notes: Silt and an erosion strip along the lane, with no agreed discrete cavity. DISPUTED: the detector describes a broken strip affecting the road, while the assistant's earlier negative label was never reviewed. Until the owner rules, this image is excluded from binary metrics.
images.labelled_by: assistant, DISPUTED: needs the owner to rule

images.label: disputed
images.notes: Assistant initially described an intact road dusty at the edges, while the detector describes a shallow road depression. DISPUTED: the negative label was never owner-reviewed. Until the owner rules, this image is excluded from binary metrics.
images.labelled_by: assistant, DISPUTED: needs the owner to rule

images.notes: Genuinely ambiguous, and the most unstable frame in the set: accepted 3/5 and 0/5 on byte-identical input. Kept out of the rates on purpose. Needs about 30 trials before any verdict on it means anything.
